links.outcome: Accuracy and quality of ChatGPT Plus answers to oral surgery clinical questions by difficulty level
links.effect: Median accuracy 5, 75% scored 4 or above; median quality 4. Hard questions scored lower than easy and medium (accuracy P<0.001, quality P=0.001).
links.quote: The median scores of hard-level questions were found to be lower than the easy-level and medium-level questions.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and quality of ChatGPT Plus responses to clinical questions in oral and maxillofacial surgery without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
